appDesc: Yusr integrates the Holy Quran, adhkar, prayer times, Qibla direction and khatma tracking into one seamless and elegant experience.
privacyText: The site uses your location only to calculate prayer times and the Qibla direction. Your last location and all your data (trackers and settings) are stored locally in your browser and are never sold or shared with third parties.
